## Review checklist

Thanks for contributing to Ruby Lore! This checklist is here to help, not
to gatekeep, if something doesn't apply (e.g. a typo fix), just leave it
unchecked and say so below.

- [ ] Claims are accurate and sourced (a link, citation, or reference a
      reviewer can check).
- [ ] Tone is warm and kind, this is a friendly history, not a takedown.
- [ ] Divisive figures are described factually and fairly, without added
      glow or taking sides.
- [ ] No live/unresolved controversy is narrated beyond neutral, sourced
      facts.
- [ ] `bundle exec ruby script/validate.rb` passes locally.
